record.title: Admit the smallest ordinary guest installation experiment
record.intent: Evaluate fixture coherence and select the shortest valid installer and persistence experiment.
requirements: Require coherent identity/key/private-store provenance and actual stock validation. If inputs remain unresolved, choose a bounded offline recovery or independent capability branch without contacting the specimen.
Admit a bounded experiment with explicit negative control and before/after/reload/reboot observations when justified. Keep physical claims and D-capability redirection separate.
Inspect taskctl plan and expected revision; commit and push admitted tasking before execution. Do not re-prove unrelated ADC or MMIO behavior.
acceptance: The next bounded offline continuation is justified
